question: What is the meaning of purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (recs) in relation to renewable energy?
data_point: purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (recs)
description: Purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (RECs) in relation to renewable energy signifies the acquisition of certificates that represent the generation of electricity from renewable sources. These credits are a way for organizations to support and promote renewable energy production without directly using the renewable energy themselves.
